hook: Turkish financial crimes police raided Halk TV in Istanbul today, halting live broadcasts completely.

sections.voiceover: Turkish financial crimes police raided Halk TV in Istanbul today, halting live broadcasts completely.
b_roll: Police officers entering the headquarters of Halk TV in Istanbul

sections.voiceover: Officers took 11 people into custody during the sudden operation. Authorities appointed a government trustee manager to oversee the station. Where did those detained staff members go?
b_roll: Law enforcement officers escorting detained individuals

sections.voiceover: This sudden raid hit Istanbul just hours before Ekrem İmamoğlu began his defense.
b_roll: Exterior view of the courthouse in Istanbul

sections.voiceover: Ekrem İmamoğlu faced defense arguments alongside 400 other defendants. Prosecutors pressed corruption charges during the ongoing courtroom proceedings. Investigators locked down the broadcaster completely.
b_roll: Mayor Ekrem İmamoğlu arriving at court

sections.voiceover: Government trustee managers now control Halk TV after arresting 11 individuals in Istanbul.
b_roll: Empty newsroom inside Halk TV headquarters
